"ZOMBIES 4: DAWN OF THE VAMPIRES [Original TV Soundtrack]") With her bright, agile singing voice, Freya Skye makes her own catchy, empowering pop music while also navigating work as an actor and singer in films, television shows, and video games. She was just 12 years old when she recorded her first single, the Junior Eurovision Song Contest entry "Lose My Head," in 2022. She starred as Nova in the Disney Channel movie musical [ZOMBIES 4: DAWN OF THE VAMPIRES](https://www.allmusic.com/album/zombies-4-dawn-of-the-vampires-mw0004579300) in 2025, the same year she released personal material such as the singles "Can't Fake It" and "silent treatment." The latter song was included on her debut EP, 2026's [stardust](https://www.allmusic.com/album/stardust-mw0004762563), which reached the U.K. Top 40. Born Freya Skye Jones in Buckinghamshire, England, Freya Skye began singing and acting at age five. Her first appearance on the international stage was at 13, when she competed in the 2022 Junior Eurovision Song Contest in Yerevan, Armenia. She represented the U.K. with her song "Lose My Head." Skye finished first in the global public vote and fifth in the official standings. At the time, she was a student at the Tring Park School for the Performing Arts. Around the same time, she began working as a voice actor in video games, including the English versions of Dragon Quest Treasures (2022) and Final Fantasy XVI (2023). In 2024, after signing with Hollywood Records, she released several effervescent pop songs, including "Who Says" and the bouncy seasonal outing "Winter Dream." She released more songs in early 2025 before appearing that July in the Disney Channel original movie [ZOMBIES 4: DAWN OF THE VAMPIRES](https://www.allmusic.com/album/zombies-4-dawn-of-the-vampires-mw0004579300), the fourth entry in the popular teen musical franchise. As Nova Bright, leader of the Daywalkers, Skye appeared on most of the songs on the movie's soundtrack, including "Snow Angels," Nova's duet with Victor ( [Malachi Barton](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/malachi-barton-mn0003936989)). She also took part of in the month-long North American arena tour Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide Tour. In addition to guest spots on TV's Wizards Beyond Waverly Place, back over on Hollywood Records, Skye released the song "silent treatment" before the end of 2025. It marked her debut on the Billboard Hot 100. In early 2026, she released her first EP, [stardust](https://www.allmusic.com/album/stardust-mw0004762563). With songwriters such as [Julia Michaels](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/julia-michaels-mn0002390968) and [Em Beihold](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/em-beihold-mn0004186337) chipping in on some of the songs, it reached number 35 in the U.K. and landed in the top half of the Billboard 200. ## [Freya Skye Discography](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/freya-skye-mn0004361731\#discography "Freya Skye Discography") Singles & EPsAll Year (Oldest to Newest)Year (Newest to Oldest)AllMusic Rating (Highest to Lowest)AllMusic Rating (Lowest to Highest)User Ratings (Highest to Lowest)User Ratings (Lowest to Highest)Album Title (A-Z)Album Title (Z-A) | | Year | Credit | AllMusic Rating | User Rating | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [![Who Says](https://fastly-s3.allmusic.com/release/mr0006359084/front/120/xm1734ShzaCLHN_rPN0vJZhUoDg0hsvx4F4sL4oO-nA=.jpg)](https://www.allmusic.com/album/who-says-mw0004271233 "Who Says") | 2024 | [Who Says](https://www.allmusic.com/album/who-says-mw0004271233 "Who Says")

# MISTLETOE AND WINE  by [CLIFF RICHARD](https://www.officialcharts.com/artist/19899/cliff-richard/)

* * *

28 years after he scored his first UK Official Singles Chart Christmas Number 1, Cliff Richard returned to the festive top spot for his 12th chart-topper, with his 99th (!) single Mistletoe and Wine.

Originally written by British songwriters Jeremy Paul, Leslie Stewart and Keith Strachan for a stage musical, 1976’s Scraps, which was an adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen’s The Little Match Girl, Cliff liked the song but asked if he could change the lyrics to make it a bit more festive and recorded it during Summer 1988, where he got into the mood by draping some tinsel over the microphone.

Released November 21, 1988, Mistletoe and Wine entered the chart at Number 7 and a week later was at Number 1 for four weeks making it 1988’s UK Official Singles Chart Christmas Number 1, and with over 750,000 sales, it became the biggest-selling single of the year too.

name: Elton John Step Into Christmas

DECEMBER 14, 2017

# Diamond Moments: ‘Step Into Christmas’

![](https://www.eltonjohn.com/cms/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/DODE1506679286diamonds_3cd_product-1024x1024.jpg)

As our final Diamond Moment from Elton’s 50-year career, celebrating the recent release of Elton’s ultimate greatest hits collection, _Diamonds_, we are presenting you with “Ten Things You May Not Have Known About **Step Into Christmas**“.

## 1

**Step Into Christmas** was the first song Elton wrote to be a stand-alone single. “The Christmas single is a real loon about and something we’d like to do a lot more of” Elton explained in a 1973 interview with _Melody Maker_. “We’ve never written a song especially tailored to be a single.” Elton and Bernie would go on to write other non-album singles, **Philadelphia Freedom** and **Don’t Go Breaking My Heart**.

![](https://www.eltonjohn.com/cms/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/1513214776StepIntoXmas-Spain45-1024x1024.jpg)

## 2

Both **Step Into Christmas** and it’s B-side **Ho, Ho, Ho (Who’d Be A Turkey At Christmas)** were written and recorded in one day – Sunday, November 11, 1973 – at Morgan Studios in London. “I came up with this pretty cool acoustic/electric guitar riff and we were off to the races!”, says Davey Johnstone.

## 3

The recording studio was owned by drummer Barry Morgan, who played drums on 11 Elton songs in 1970 and 1971. Barry was the drummer on, amongst others, **Levon**, **Burn Down The Mission**, **Bad Side Of The Moon** and **Your Song**.

## 4

A number of guest musicians appear on **Step Into Christmas**. Kiki Dee and members of her band happened to be in the studio at the same time, so Kiki and guitarist Jo Partridge sang background vocals (along with Elton’s band, Davey, Dee, and Nigel) and drummer Roger Pope played tambourine. And, according to Davey, “\[Producer\] Gus Dudgeon and \[engineer\] David Hentschel came up with the ‘reindeer’ sound after the first ‘the admission’s free’ bit.” David played the ARP on that part.

![](https://www.eltonjohn.com/cms/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/1513214083StepIntoChristmas_tracksheet-1024x1014.jpg)

## Step 1

## 6

The single was released on November 23 in Britain (tucked in between **Goodbye Yellow Brick Road**, which was still on the UK Singles Chart, and early 1974’s **Candle In The Wind**) and peaked at #24 during a 7-week run. In the US it reached #1 on the _Billboard_ Christmas Singles chart in December 1973.

'Step Into Christmas" official video. (1973)

## 7

The video was filmed early one morning (for Elton, anyway) a week or so after the song was recorded.

In it, Elton’s lyricist Bernie Taupin can be seen “hitting” the gongs (actually played by percussionist Ray Cooper), during the instrumental break…after which Elton holds up his beloved Watford Hornets Football Club membership card.

During the third verse of the video, the band members switch instruments: Nigel (drums) is on guitar, Elton plays drums and then bass, Dee (bass) plays piano, and Davey can be seen on drums.

As Davey explains, “It was a very loony video. Crazy days. It still gets played regularly over the Christmas holidays!!”

## 8

**Step Into Christmas** was recently issued a Silver award by the British Phonographic Industry. As of this article, it has appeared on the UK Singles Chart in six of the past ten Decembers, for a total of 27 weeks. In 2009 it was the ninth most played Christmas song in the UK and in 2017 it reached #19, becoming his 46th UK Top 20 hit.

## 9

**Step Into Christmas** has been covered by:

The Wedding Present (1992), The Business (a punk version in 2007), The Puppini Sisters (Big Band in 2010), and The Christmas All-Stars (2015). Max McCabe gave it a Country turn in 2016.

## 10

A marvelous remastered version of **Step Into Christmas** closes disc 3 of the Deluxe version of Elton’s new greatest hits package _Diamonds_.

It previously has appeared on the 1995 reissue of _Caribou_ as well as Elton’s _To Be Continued…_, _Rare Masters_, and _Elton John’s Christmas Party_ compilations.

# ED SHEERAN

## Who is Ed Sheeran?

Ed Sheeran (born February 17 1991) has become one of the most popular acts in UK chart history - and one that actually helped re-write chart rules. In 2017, all 16 tracks of his album Divide debuted inside the Top 40, necessitating a change that entries in the chart are now limited to three per lead artist.

Ed’s debut appearance on the Official Singles Chart came in June 2011 with his breakthrough hit A Team, which peaked at Number 3. Three years later in June 2014 he went on to bag his first Number 1 single with Sing, featuring Pharrell Williams.

In December 2019 the Official Charts Company crowned Ed as the Official Number 1 Artist Of The Decade 2010-2019. 2021 was another particularly big year for Ed, who not only scored his fifth UK Number 1 album with = (Equals) but four Number 1 singles too - Bad Habits, Shivers, Merry Christmas with Elton John, and Sausage Rolls For Everyone with Ladbaby.

On the 19 September 2025, Ed Sheeran [achieved his ninth Official UK Number 1](https://www.officialcharts.com/chart-news/ed-sheeran-play-number-1-album/) album with [Play](https://www.officialcharts.com/albums/ed-sheeran-play/).

# DJ PLAY A CHRISTMAS SONG  by [CHER](https://www.officialcharts.com/artist/11931/cher/)

* * *

DJ Play A Christmas Song is the lead single taken from [Cher's first ever Christmas album](https://www.officialcharts.com/albums/cher-christmas/ "Cher - Christmas"). In December 2023 it vaulted into the Official UK Top 40 at Number 20, landing Cher in the history books as [the first female artist to achieve a Top 40 hit with new material on the Official Singles Chart](https://www.officialcharts.com/chart-news/cher-chart-record-dj-play-christmas-song/) across seven consecutive decades. At the same time, at 77 years, 7 months old, Cher also became the oldest solo female performer ever to secure a Top 40 on the Official Singles Chart with the track.

The three-and-a-half minute song is the opener to Cher's 13-track festive album, Christmas, an album produced by long-time collaborator Mark Taylor (Believe) and featuring appearances from Stevie Wonder, Tyga, Cyndi Lauper, Michael Bublé and more.

Speaking to Billboard about the release, Cher said “I had no intention of doing a Christmas album, but \[Warner Records\] said, ‘Why don’t you do a Christmas album, Cher?’ and I said if I can do my version I’ll do it, and they were very pleasant.”
